free_tier.stated: A Lighthouse instance in an overseas region at CNY 99 a year: 2 vCPU, 2 GiB RAM, 30 Mbps, 1000 GB a month, buyable by new and existing Tencent Cloud accounts and renewable once at the same price, so CNY 198 covers two years. The next shape up is 2 vCPU / 4 GiB / 30 Mbps / 1500 GB at CNY 199 a year. Regions named across the threads are Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Silicon Valley, Frankfurt, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Beijing, and the plan includes free IP replacement.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: CNY 99 for two years of a 30 Mbps overseas box is the cheapest credible origin, and it composes with a free CDN in front to take the 1 TB cap off the serving path; the annual renewal is the only cliff.

limits.value: One terabyte a month at 30 Mbps is the first thing to bind, and at the stated port speed a full month of saturation would move far more than the cap, so the plan is a service box. The renewal limit is the second: the same price is good for one renewal only, after which the list price applies.

identity_cost.detail: The promotion runs on the mainland storefront cloud.tencent.com, which requires a real-name verified account before any purchase; the international storefront tencentcloud.com sells Lighthouse separately and is not covered by this price.
